def check(candidate):
    print(candidate(
        pd.Series([1, 2, 3]),
        pd.Series([2, 3, 4])
    ))

    print(candidate(
        pd.Series([1, 1, 2, 2]),
        pd.Series([3, 3, 4])
    ))

    print(candidate(
        pd.Series([1, None, 2, 2]),
        pd.Series([2, None, 3])
    ))

    print(candidate(
        pd.Series([-2, -1, 0]),
        pd.Series([-1, 0, 1])
    ))

    print(candidate(
        pd.Series([], dtype=float),
        pd.Series([1, 2, 3])
    ))
